# Rectifyq

> Malaysia's independent cybersecurity threat intelligence platform.
> Founded and operated by Rectifyq (Threat Intelligence & OT/ICS).
> Tracks 47+ threat actor groups with Malaysian relevance. All intelligence is MISP-compatible and mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.

## Core intelligence
- [MY Threat Landscape](https://rectifyq.com/MY-Threat-Landscape/): All tracked threat events targeting Malaysia
- [Threat Actor Tracker](https://rectifyq.com/threat-actors/): 47+ groups, Diamond Model mapped
- [Ransomware Tracker](https://rectifyq.com/ransomware/): Live Malaysia ransomware victim tracker
- [Threat List](https://rectifyq.com/MY-Threat-Landscape/threat-lists/): List of all articles, security blogs and reports that are relevant to Malaysian context

## MISP feeds
- [MISP-MY](https://feeds.rectifyq.com/MISP-MY/): Structured indicator sharing, MITRE ATT&CK mapped MISP formatted feeds compiling all MISP event relevant to Malaysian context
- [MISP-ICS-OT](https://feeds.rectifyq.com/MISP-ICS-OT/): OT/ICS-specific feed (Global context)

## About
- Analyst: Rectifyq — SANS GCTI, GRID, BTL1, BTL2 certified and passionate on Threat Intelligence
